scope: Offline browser mock interaction checks only; NOT Runtime/integration/production tests
limitations: Rendered via page.set_content; file and localhost navigation blocked by environment policy
localStorage is a test double; real browser reload durability NOT verified
No production identity, concurrency, network or Runtime test

tests.name: 01 Missing material blocks preview and execution
02 Preview is not approval
03 Changed arguments invalidate prior approval
04 Rejection causes no business write
05 After-sale case verifies only the application
06 Duplicate clicks create one operation attempt
07 Submission timeout is unknown, not failed
08 Read-only reconciliation recovers without repeat write
09 Pre-submission failure performs no write
10 Outbox-only retry does not redo the business
11 Pending is not verified completion
12 Partial mismatch requires human handling
13 Cancellation waits for stop and does not claim rollback
14 Simulated restart hydrates unknown state; mocked storage
15 Quote case returns a draft, not a sales commitment
16 Invalid quote quantity blocks preview
17 Entered text is not interpreted as HTML
18 Evidence carries demo identity and reread source
19 Responsive page has no mobile horizontal overflow
20 No external network calls or browser script errors
